title: Vote: add stats-only fields for v4
summary: Ryan Blue called a vote on adding stats-only fields to the table spec, following an earlier discussion thread, with the changes in PR #18405. The change adds a stats-fields list that assigns table field IDs so that statistics for partition fields and for expressions such as to_lower_case can be stored in the content_stats struct. The vote was open for 72 hours. Every reply was a +1 vote, with no discussion of the content in the thread. Ryan Blue closed the vote three days later, stating that it passed with 15 +1 votes and no -1 or -0 votes.

positions.stance: Add a stats-fields list assigning field IDs so stats for partition fields and expressions can be stored in content_stats.

outcome.note: Passed with 15 +1 votes and no -1 or -0, as stated in the result message, which does not split binding and non-binding.

why_it_matters: V4 content stats can now carry statistics for partition fields and expressions through dedicated stats-only field IDs.
